requirements: Implement monetary line totals with Decimal(str(unit_price)); quantity must be a non-negative int, excluding bool, otherwise raise ValueError.
discount_percent must be 0..100 inclusive, otherwise raise ValueError; apply it before rounding to 0.01 using ROUND_HALF_UP.
order_total must pass each optional discount_percent (default 0) to line_total and sum rounded line totals; empty order is Decimal("0.00").
Keep existing public function signatures. Monetary returns must have exactly two decimal places.
forbidden_operations: Do not change tests or add dependencies.
Do not access network, secrets, source repository or Git metadata.
Do not delete files, commit, merge or push.

acceptance.description: Discounts and HALF_UP monetary rounding pass fixed tests
Reject invalid quantity and discount inputs
Pass discounts through order totals and support empty orders
